Subscriber.title: Subscriber
Subscriber.description: An ISP internet subscriber profile with identity, location, monthly billing plan, pending dues, and cumulative paid totals.

userId.description: Authenticated operator UID owning this subscriber record.

subscriberCode.description: ISP User ID or PPPoE login identifier (e.g., NET-1042).

fullName.description: Full name of the internet subscriber.

areaZone.description: Sector, block, or neighborhood zone for route grouping.

packageName.description: Internet bandwidth package name (e.g., 30 Mbps Fiber).

monthlyBill.description: Recurring monthly subscription fee in PKR.

pendingBill.description: Current unpaid outstanding balance in PKR.

totalPaid.description: Cumulative amount paid to date in PKR.

lastBilledMonth.description: Most recent YYYY-MM cycle billed to this subscriber.

notes.description: Optional installation, router, or billing notes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when subscriber was added (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when subscriber was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Immutable receipt record for a collected subscriber bill payment.

userId.description: Authenticated operator UID owning this payment receipt.

subscriberId.description: Document ID of the subscriber who paid.

subscriberName.description: Denormalized subscriber full name at time of payment.

subscriberCode.description: Denormalized subscriber User ID at time of payment.

note.description: Optional transaction reference or collector note.

/users/{userId}/payments/{paymentId}.description: User-isolated collection of subscriber bill payment receipts.
